name: What's the difference between a kitchen refresh and a full remodel?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a kitchen refresh and a full remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A kitchen refresh focuses on cosmetic updates without altering the layout. This might include repainting cabinets, replacing countertops, upgrading appliances, and installing a new backsplash or lighting. A full remodel, however, often involves changing the kitchen's layout, relocating plumbing or electrical, and replacing all major components. It can also include structural modifications, resulting in a more extensive project with a greater impact on the space and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: A refresh updates cosmetics without changing layout, while a full remodel often involves significant layout changes, plumbing/electrical relocation, and structural modifications.
